# Tour

As of event 01M6Q8VWDGMCP17BJ1S9R6CDG4. Five stops through this repository, with real examples.

## Stop 1: what lives where

This repository keeps two lines of history. The **code branch** holds the code. The **ticket branch** (this one) holds one file per ticket, the event log under `.events/`, and the generated pages such as the front door (`README.md`), the glossary (`GLOSSARY.md`), the indexes (`indexes/README.md`) and the guide (`guide/README.md`). Tickets are written only through `frob ticket ...`; generated pages are rewritten only by `frob ticket reindex`.

## Stop 2: an epic

An epic groups tickets under one directory with its own page. The largest epic here is [M2: universal model, grimble foundation, neatness and CI families](m2-universal-model-grimble-foundation-neatness-and-ci/EPIC.md) (~0BTGRT5) with 330 tickets. Its page lists the tickets by sub-epic and then by status, so open the page to see where the work stands.

## Stop 4: the rules that guard the repository

`frob check` runs the built-in rules and the tool stages configured for this repository; `frob check --ticket ~HANDLE` scopes the run to one ticket.
